name: wait-for-verification-email
description: SHARED CHUNK — polls the email inbox API until a verification code is extracted, then exposes it as {{get-verification-code.result.code}}. Provider-agnostic: the API endpoint (emailWorkerUrl) and the extraction logic (extractionJs) are macro INPUTS, so switching email providers or fixing a changed email format means editing inputs, not extension code. Default provider: ImprovMX (priv.email). Inline these steps into a service macro (signup etc.) and override extractionJs per service. The emailWorkerToken input is the raw Basic-auth pair (e.g. 'api:sk_...') or a ready-made 'Basic ...'/'Bearer ...' header value.

inputs.extractionJs: (args) => { try { const data = JSON.parse(args.body); const logs = data.logs || data.results || []; const sinceMs = Number(args.sinceMs) || 0; const recipient = (args.email || '').toLowerCase(); let best = null; for (const log of logs) { const created = log.created || 0; if (sinceMs && created && created < sinceMs) continue; const to = ((log.recipient && log.recipient.email) || '').toLowerCase(); if (recipient && to && to !== recipient) continue; if (!best || created > best.created) best = { created, subject: log.subject || '', id: log.id }; } if (!best) return { code: null, reason: logs.length ? 'no email newer than sinceMs for this recipient' : 'no emails yet', logCount: logs.length }; const subj = best.subject; const layers = [ /([A-Za-z0-9]{4,10})\s+is\s+(?:your|the)\b.{0,20}?(?:code|passcode|token)/i, /(?:login|verification|verify|signup|sign[- ]?up|passcode|pass|security|access|one[- ]?time|temporary|auth)\s+(?:code|passcode|token)[^A-Za-z0-9]{0,20}([A-Za-z0-9]{4,10})\b/i, /\bcode(?:\s+is)?[:\s]+([A-Za-z0-9]{4,10})\b/i ]; for (const re of layers) { const m = subj.match(re); if (m && /^[A-Za-z0-9]+$/.test(m[1])) return { code: m[1], source: 'subject', subject: subj.slice(0, 100), logId: best.id }; } return { code: null, reason: 'no code pattern in subject', subject: subj.slice(0, 100), logCount: logs.length }; } catch (e) { return { code: null, error: e.message }; } }

steps.function: (args) => { const t = (args.token || '').trim(); if (!t) return { ok: false, error: 'emailWorkerToken input is empty — set it in the popup config panel (Email API token)' }; if (/^(basic|bearer)\s+/i.test(t)) return { header: t }; try { return { header: 'Basic ' + btoa(t) }; } catch (e) { return { ok: false, error: 'cannot build Authorization header (non-Latin1 token?): ' + e.message }; } }
